parsed.summary: The change introduces a newline parameter to the file opening, which might affect other parts of the codebase.

issues.description: The change might introduce a behavioral regression risk by affecting how other parts of the codebase handle newline characters.
The change does not follow the project's convention of not specifying the newline parameter, which might lead to inconsistencies.
